# Maintained numerical supplier

photometric.mjs is copied byte-for-byte from MATERIALTRUTH commit
97ab037255ffa21faafb47f66f46413bc1829997, app/photometric.mjs.
source.json records its Git blob and SHA-256. Circular reference inference
uses the existing three-column qrSolve entrypoint. The solver remains owned
by MATERIALTRUTH; no forked numerical kernel or browser network request.
